channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sam Jones | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sam Jones from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Michael Jordan, Sam Jones
item.description:
“He’d talk about shooting the bank shot. He always made the point that he had more rings than Michael Jordan. Sam had 10 championship rings and he’d say how people would talk about (Bill) Russell, then they would always skip him and K.C. Jones and go right to Michael.”

Cedric Maxwell on Michael Jordan, Sam Jones, Jan 1, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Adam Silver on Sam Jones
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Statement from Adam Silver:

“Sam Jones will be remembered as one of the most prolific champions in all of professional sports. His selfless style, clutch performances & signature bank shot were hallmarks of an incredible career that featured 10 NBA championships in 12 seasons.”

Adam Silver on Sam Jones, Dec 31, 2021. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: John Havlicek on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Sam Jones
item.description:
John Havlicek:

“If Oscar Robertson and Jerry West hadn't been around, Sam Jones would have been the best guard in the NBA.”

John Havlicek on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Sam Jones, Apr 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.
